budget.coverage_warning: The v1 lower bound excludes detector inference, metrics, image decode, tiling/blending, artifact I/O, validation, retries, and writing.
budget.hard_monitor: Pause before exceeding 240 GPU-hours and report the measured cause; do not silently remove an arm, seed, backbone, or cohort.

deadline_state.truthfulness_rule: This gate closes compute authorization only and does not represent journal approval of the requested deadline.

decision_basis.author_instruction: Execute the complete predeclared scope without reduction.
decision_basis.decision_timing: Recorded before any WP1 full-training performance result or endpoint result was inspected.
decision_basis.operational_change: The former 144 GPU-hour planning ceiling is superseded by a 240 GPU-hour monitored execution budget.

hard_stops: Any frozen source, contract, implementation, preflight, stream, or G11 closure hash mismatch.
Any paired-arm initial-state, sample-stream, target, degradation, or output-domain mismatch.
Any unplanned model, arm, seed, checkpoint selection, or endpoint selection after result inspection.
Any non-finite loss or gradient, corrupted checkpoint, or unavailable recovery path.
Measured execution reaches 240 GPU-hours before numerical freeze.
required_before_wp1: Freeze the restart-capable WP1 runner and sequential queue by SHA-256.
Pass a bounded end-to-end checkpoint/resume pilot for all three families and both arms.
Verify adequate local storage and an idle CUDA device.

scope.field_evaluation: All 974 frozen full-resolution frames for all six WP1 checkpoints per backbone; no family is removed from the field cohort.
scope.wp1: 3 official backbones x 2 arms x 3 seeds = 18 fixed-final runs
